releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.9.2 - App Flow Control (Block Facebook/YouTube/TikTok)
releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ NEW: App Flow Control — block Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, WhatsApp, Netflix, PUBG, Free Fire and more per plan from the app dashboard (Dashboard > App Flow Control)
• 🛡️ Toggle services ON/OFF with a single tap — applies MikroTik firewall Layer7 rules instantly to the router
• 🔧 v1.9.1 fixes preserved: Active Sessions crash fix, delete-safety, readable theme, crash logger

Install over v1.9.1/v1.8.0/v1.6.3 — same signature, no uninstall.
